notes: Company aliases that are also ordinary English, and therefore cannot establish a ticker on their own. Two sources feed this list. (1) Aliases already in the security master as single tokens -- of 3,445 scannable aliases only 160 are single tokens and only four were everyday words, but one is 'bullish' -> BLSH and 'I am very bullish on Israel' is not a claim about a crypto exchange. (2) Single-token forms CREATED by stripping corporate suffixes for spoken-form matching: 'recall holdings' -> 'recall' matched 'you might recall that we always used to have...' in a Fundsmith webinar and filed it as REC.AX. An alias listed here still counts when a DIFFERENT alias of the same company appears in the same transcript -- 'alphabet' rides on 'google' -- it simply cannot establish the company alone. The same list gates acronym expansion, so 'general motors' never contributes the token 'general'.
